source.title: Newry Reporter, 30 April 1936, p. 5 ("Newry No. 2 Rural Council: Contests Probable in Three Divisions")
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1936: nominations received by W. R. Bell, J.P., 28 April 1936. Party labels are not printed for the unopposed members. No nominations for Camly, Creggan, Drumbanagher, Lathbirget, Mountnorris, Mullaghbane, Poyntzpass and Tullyhappy, where the sitting members (not named) were automatically re-elected. Returned unopposed.
